identity.title: [v0.92][C-SDLC v2][blocker] Permit bind-safe deferred new module and test targets

review_prompts: Is the exception impossible outside initialized pre-bind admission?
Does every deferred source and test path require exact ownership and deliverable equality?
Is the temporary path harness route issue-owned, focused, and incapable of registering an arbitrary production module?
Do negative tests independently prove each required fail-closed predicate?
Can prose still be mistaken for a required validator path?
residual_risk: The pre-bind #[path] contract is a textual declaration until the test file exists; post-bind target existence and execution remain the proving boundary.
The live child cards require the demonstrated typed STP/VPP normalization before binding; issue #79 enables but does not mutate child-owned records.
